name: GET /api/leadflow/dashboards/:role - the five role views
description:
The role-scoped dashboard. Each role gets the panels its work needs and not the others: a rep gets pipeline health without the source breakdown, client success gets onboarding attainment, revenue operations gets everything.

AN UNKNOWN ROLE IS REFUSED rather than rendered empty. An empty dashboard reads as "nothing to do", which is the most dangerous thing a dashboard can say when it actually means "I did not understand your role". QA: measured live, including the refusal.

testCases.name: A known role returns its scoped panels
An unknown role is REFUSED rather than rendered empty
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: role must be one of leadership, sales_manager, sales_rep, client_success, revenue_operations - an unknown role would render an empty dashboard that reads as "nothing to do"
errorCases.when: the role is outside the five known ones.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
